_comment: Behavior settings for mini_picker.py. Looks live in themes/*.json. The picker rewrites this file when you rebind controller buttons (L), cycle the theme (T), move the window, or load a different roster (START on the pad).
_students_file: Path to the roster .txt, one name per line. Relative paths resolve against this folder; absolute paths work too. The file is re-read about once a second while running, so edits land without a restart.
_theme: Filename (without .json) of a theme in themes/. T on the keyboard or theme_button on the pad cycles through them.

controller._comment: Which pad button does what. In normal use you only need pick_button (NEXT) - the pool refills itself when everyone has been called, so reset is optional. Easiest way to set these: press L in the window and it walks you through pick / theme / reset / roster - press the button you want for each (S skips one, Esc cancels), and your choices are written back here. Press H in the window to see the current mapping. Set null to leave an action unmapped. Buttons are names: A B X Y LB RB LT RT VIEW MENU HOME L3 R3 (aliases like L1 or START work too; raw numbers still work). The profile (controllers/<profile>.json at the repo root) turns each name into the number your pad sends - if a name lands on the wrong button, fix the profile with 'uv run map_controller.py' rather than editing here. The D-pad is a hat, not buttons.

window._comment: width/height are the window size in pixels; null means use the size the theme was designed at. Resize by dragging the grip in the bottom-right corner, or with + / - (0 resets), and everything on screen scales with it. Screen position in pixels; null centers it. Drag the window with the left mouse button and the new spot is saved here - if that spot turns out to be off-screen next time (projector unplugged), the window centers itself instead. always_on_top keeps the window above your slides and is re-asserted every couple of seconds so a full-screen slideshow cannot bury it; press O to toggle it.

_spin_ms: How long the names shuffle before landing. Set 0 to jump straight to the winner.
_no_repeats: true = a picked student leaves the pool until everyone has been called. false = every pick draws from the full roster.

hotkey._comment: Keyboard backup for NEXT. This is a global hook: it works while your slides have focus, which is exactly when you need it. The key is not swallowed, so pick one your slides ignore - 'x' is safe; 'p' toggles presenter view and 'space' advances the slide. Only a real key press triggers it; keys sent by another program (controller_remote.py) are ignored. Set enabled false, or next null, to turn the hook off. Combos work: "ctrl+space", "f9".
